_comment: Synthetic schema example for /api/anchor-receipt.schema.v1.json. This file is NOT a snapshot of any production inscription — it is a fixed demonstration of the schema's shape. All hex strings, tx_ids, block numbers, sink-account names, and timestamps shown here are synthetic placeholders that document field formats only; they do not refer to any real on-chain transaction, account, or moment in time. The placeholder sink name 'fyldsink' is one of the candidates under operator judgment per project_phase_alpha_coordination_log.md (judgment #1); the production receipt will substitute the operator-selected name. Production runtime receipt is published at /api/anchor-receipt.json by scripts/post-anchor-event.sh on the validator host. See docs/MERKLE_DAG_SPEC.md.
